title: TestFile
description: A WhyNoRun Test file, committed at .github/whynorun/<name>.test.yml: one or more Behaviour tests, each a Scenario and the Verdicts pinned for it.

version.description: The Test file format version, separate from the package version.

test.title: Test
test.description: One Behaviour test. Labels are unique within the file.

scenario.description: Exactly the Scenario simulate() takes, with every default written out.

pins.description: Keyed by subject key, such as "ci.yml › test › secrets" or "check › test".

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: A missing field isn't compared; null means the Verdict must not have that field. possible and continuing compare as sets.

continuing.description: The job keys a cancelled run A keeps running.
